items.title: Return completed accident questionnaire
items.quote: Bitte senden Sie uns den ausgefüllten Fragebogen innerhalb von 10 Arbeitstagen (Montag bis Freitag, ohne Feiertage) nach dem Briefdatum zurück.
items.computation: This is a private deadline set by the insurer, counted from the letter date under §§ 187, 188 BGB with 'Arbeitstage' defined by the letter itself as Monday-Friday excluding public holidays. Letter date (Briefdatum) = Wed 06.05.2026; as the day of the triggering event, it is not counted, so counting starts on Thu 07.05.2026. Counting only Mon-Fri, excluding NW public holidays: Thu 07.05 (1), Fri 08.05 (2), [Sat 09/Sun 10 skipped], Mon 11.05 (3), Tue 12.05 (4), Wed 13.05 (5), Thu 14.05 = Christi Himmelfahrt/Ascension Day, a nationwide holiday, excluded, Fri 15.05 (6), [Sat 16/Sun 17 skipped], Mon 18.05 (7), Tue 19.05 (8), Wed 20.05 (9), Thu 21.05 (10). The 10th business day is Thu 21.05.2026, which is itself a normal working day, so no further weekend/holiday shift applies.

warnings: This is a private request from your own insurer for information about the accident, not a decision or a bill; there is no legal remedy instruction (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) and none is required.
